svg.title: Tech stack on three conveyor belts
svg.desc: Three conveyor belts carry the headline tools, eight per belt; the toolbox lists every tool. Front-end: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TanStack Query, Vite. Back-end and data: Node.js, Express, Hono, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker. Machine learning and tooling: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, Streamlit, Vitest, GitHub Actions.
